channel.title: CNN 5 Things
channel.description: Monday through Friday get up to speed on the biggest headlines of the day with 5 Things. On Saturdays, get a break for your ears with good news from 5 Good Things. And at noon and Sundays, we take you beyond the headlines to help make sense of what everyone is talking about in politics and beyond with One Thing.

item.title: What Democrats Plan to Do with Their Power in Congress
item.itunes:title: What Democrats Plan to Do with Their Power in Congress
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Once Democrats take control in the House and Senate in January, what will they do with it? We examine why House leadership battles could become contentious and why an impeachment vote against Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth could happen even before new members are sworn in. 

--- 

Guest: Sarah Ferris, CNN Senior Reporter 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin

item.title: Deep in the Heart of an Upset: How Texas Turned Blue
item.itunes:title: Deep in the Heart of an Upset: How Texas Turned Blue
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
The stunning Senate and gubernatorial victories for Democrats in deep-red Texas were among the highlights of a historic Election Night for the party. But is it a flash in the pan, or part of a broader sea change? We explore where the MAGA erosion is most prominent in the state and look at why Elon Musk’s millions barely made a dent. 

--- 

Guest: Jeff Zeleny, CNN Chief National Affairs Correspondent 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin
